prompt: A cinematic film still captures a vibrant rooftop party at night. In the center, a woman in a silver dress holds a champagne flute while looking at a man in a black tuxedo who stands next to her. To the left, a guitarist in a blue shirt strums an acoustic guitar while sitting on a wooden crate. Beside him, a girl in a pink hoodie leans against the railing, pointing at the city skyline below. A brown dog sits calmly near the guitarist, watching a waiter in a white apron who is handing a tray of canapés to a guest in a green suit. On the right, a couple dances closely; the man wears a striped shirt and the woman wears a yellow skirt. Behind them, a bartender in a black vest pours a drink into a glass for a patron in a leather jacket. Near the edge, a photographer in a denim jacket adjusts the lens of a large camera, focusing on a singer in a sequined top who performs into a microphone stand. A small child in a red cap runs past the dancers, chasing a blue balloon that floats above the crowd. An elderly man in a gray coat watches the scene from a high stool, holding a cigar. A potted palm tree stands tall in the corner, its leaves brushing against the string lights overhead. There is no rain falling from the sky. There is no snow on the ground.
